status: functional RTL adapter; board integration and R40 acceptance remain open

address.admission: complete line fits axi_size; base/end cannot overflow uint64; invalid requests fault and are refused
address.controller_assignment: existing unique home modulo memory outlet count; no new home hash
address.capacity: each outlet exposes its configured logical window; neither duplicated simulator storage nor AXI width establishes board capacity

request_order: same line with any write waits until prior AXI completion; different lines and read/read overlap
response: read bursts assemble one complete line with original home source/tag; NUCA writebacks receive no home response; B completion frees adapter slot
ids: independent outstanding slot IDs; tags may repeat across homes and writebacks

links.request: two-entry FIFO per stage, ready derives from registered occupancy, no combinational ready propagation across stages
links.response: one full-line register per stage, no backpressure at home interface
links.placement: platform must place stages and supply constraints; functional RTL does not establish three-SLR routing/timing

completion: public done_valid/cmd_ready/all_idle wait for every adapter and request/response link to drain; physical AXI error overrides done status to 1
fault: sticky on AXI error, stray ID, malformed burst or invalid address; stop adapter admission and global issue; drain valid accepted AXI responses; lost/malformed responses or queued requests blocked behind a fault require platform reset, never a fabricated successful completion
reset: platform must reset AXI fabric and attached controller along with core/link/adapter; resetting the adapter alone with outstanding AW/W/R/B is unsupported
counters: 64-bit free-running accepted AR/AW line transactions and R/W beats; not board HBM measurement

ideal_limits_bytes_per_cycle.read: min(32, DATA_W/8), one captured request plus AR cycle; ignores latency/credits/backpressure
ideal_limits_bytes_per_cycle.write: 64/(512/DATA_W+1), serialized noninterleaved W bursts plus request capture; ignores B/credits/backpressure
ideal_limits_bytes_per_cycle.link: 64 per direction per outlet at steady state; finite FIFO may stall
